svg.aria-label: The cover of Distributed Systems from the Ground Up. On a stormy night 5 lighthouses stand on rocks in the sea, each kept by a crab, and beams of light join their lamps into a ring. Lightning strikes one lighthouse: its lamp is dark, its beams are broken, and its crab is shocked. The other 4 lamps still shine, and a paper boat carrying the word PUT sails safely between them. A sign reads: 4 of 5 still agree.
